crossRefs.note: Give ear to my words, Yahweh. Consider my meditation.
Listen to the voice of my cry, my King and my God; for I pray to you.
Hear, Yahweh, my righteous plea; Give ear to my prayer, that doesn’t go out of deceitful lips.
Lord, hear my voice. Let your ears be attentive to the voice of my petitions.

translations.web: Hear, Yahweh, my prayer. Listen to the voice of my petitions.
translations.bsb: Hear my prayer, O LORD, and attend to my plea for mercy.
translations.kjv: Give ear, O LORD, unto my prayer; and attend to the voice of my supplications.
translations.asv: Give ear, O Jehovah, unto my prayer; And hearken unto the voice of my supplications.
